text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway when I
hear
someone come up quickly behind
me.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer! I'd like to discuss
Jordan's
recent exam with you...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's up? You need me for something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: ...Sounds like you failed.
...Sounds like you failed, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Teehee. ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "We"? Oh come on, seriously?!
choice_data_list: Don't “tee-hee” me, we're studying for that retest.
Don't “tee-hee” me, we're studying for that retest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Students typically have to keep retaking
tests
until they manage to pass, so the
longer that
takes, the less time they
have to practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing a test also provides a sense of

accomplishment, which is sure to have a
positive
effect on her growth as a runner.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Don't you want to "win" against the test?
Don't you want to 'beat' the test?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You really think making it like a race is
gonna
motivate me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is having a staring contest
with the
question sheet on her desk.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ummm... uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I've got no clue... What do I write?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the formula. Like, there's
way too
much stuff to remember...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she failed because she
couldn't
memorize the material well
enough.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Then let's try learning it through movement!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um... What's this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hand her a notepad with all the
formulas she
needs to know for the
makeup test.
choice_data_list: Try jogging lightly while saying that out loud!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
While running? No way! That's so
embarrassing!
Not happening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Science tells us that light exercise can
aid in
memorization. For an Umamusume,
studying while
running sounds perfect.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Or are you going to let the test beat you?
Or will you let the test beat you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No fair! Don't say it like that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Tangent! Equals! Sine over cosine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhhhh, F=ma?!
choice_data_list: What about the equation of motion?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Jordan! You passed all your
makeup
tests!
choice_data_list: That's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Great job? I know. I'm just too good,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, mostly because my trainer made
me do this
silly exercise.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you got study tips from your trainer?
Does
that mean there's a secret study
method that
works on you? I'll have to
ask for the details.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I really don't think that's a good idea.
Copying
Trainer is not gonna be a good
look.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... I don't think I'd listen if
anyone else
told me to do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a glance at the problem Tosen
Jordan is
working through. It looks like a
mathematical
proof.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So n is an odd number, which means n is
2k + 1,
and then...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Something seems off. What was it
the
teacher said earlier...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan pulls out her eraser and
completely
erases her partially solved
equation.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Cause I was definitely doing it wrong.
Why bother
when you know it's gonna
get a big fat red X?
choice_data_list: Why did you delete everything?
Why did you delete everything?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a proof, she can still get partial
credit
for the correct parts even if she
ends up with the
wrong answer.
choice_data_list: Even if it's not the right answer, write something down.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Besides, I want to show the teacher proof of your hard work.
Besides, I want to show the teacher proof of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You really are a trainer through and through.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Just what I said.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan continues working
diligently on her
practice problems.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I just barely failed my makeup test.
Gotta do it
again.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I'll definitely get it next time. Even
my
teacher said so, because I've been
working so
hard.
choice_data_list: I see~

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling she's more motivated
than usual
in her training today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, real talk, do you think studying is,
like,
important?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I bet you can't solve these problems
either. Be
honest, you've forgotten all
these formulas,
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan looks at me doubtfully, so
I glance
at her test.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The subject appears to be math,
specifically
probability. Looking more
closely, it involves
combinations, which
means...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I knew it! You don't remember!
choice_data_list: ...What was that formula again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's like all the knowledge flew out of my
head as
soon as I looked at it. I was
pretty good with
math when I was in
school...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah?
choice_data_list: But I do remember how hard you studied.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now? ...Oh.
choice_data_list: Maybe that's why I've been able to keep up with my studies now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Do trainers have things they have to
study too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take out a notepad and write down the
problem
that she's been working on.
choice_data_list: That said, maybe I'll try studying again too!
That said, maybe I'll try studying again too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! We're competing?! H-hang on a
sec!
choice_data_list: Race you to see who solves it first!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You've already started working on it!
Cheater! No
false starts!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Let me get this straight... You'd like to
take the
makeup test as well?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Are you out of your mind?!
choice_data_list: Because that'll get Jordan way more motivated!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for the results... Well, let's just say it
was a
good competition for the both of
us.
